description: Geocoding and reverse geocoding from GeoNames: city, town or postal code to lat/lon, and lat/lon to the nearest place and postal code. Covers 170,000 places with 1000+ inhabitants and 1.8 million postal codes worldwide, answered from our own database in milliseconds. Not street level: house numbers and streets are skipped and reported in ignored_parts. Provide address (e.g. 'Paris, Texas', '10115 Berlin') or lat + lon. Price: $0.005 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"address":"Brandenburger Tor, Berlin"}.

inputSchema.description: Provide either 'address' for forward geocoding, or both 'lat' + 'lon' for reverse geocoding.

address.description: Place to geocode: city, 'city, region', 'city, country' or postal code (e.g. 'Zurich', 'Springfield, Illinois', '10115, Germany', 'SW1A')

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default: 1, max: 5)

name: geocode
